notes.title: Dev Update #2: Build 3 (Arena Champions)
notes.notes: [p]Hey guys,[/p][p][/p][p]This large content update mainly focuses on implementing the remaining 5 Grand Arena champions for Arena Monarchy. AM launched into EA with 90% of the content already implemented with the main goal just being tweaks and catching bugs. The scope and scale was a lot smaller compared to Dead Monarchy but at the same time, given that combat is still the main focus, overall each content drop is quite meaty.[/p][p][/p][p]This update will be the last major update for Arena Monarchy as now I am shifting towards implementing this content back into Dead Monarchy.[/p][p][/p][p]Grand Arena Champions:[/p][p][/p][p]- Krixus, Auctus, Darcus, Tacius and Maximus. The Grand Arena champions become available after defeating all the Pit champions.[/p][p][/p][p]- New unique equipment has been added, from the new bosses.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45376518/22f8204a3be6bab854daa86e86384f2f3d68e7c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]- Grand Arena champions and by extension "Argonaut" type units are the most difficult enemies that AM and by extension DM have to offer. Since they have stats and perks that go beyond the standard level, I'm happy to announce that the level cap has now been extended.[/p][p][/p][p]- Maximum level is now increased to level 31.[/p][p][/p][p]- Maximum experience is now increased to 850,000.[/p][p][/p][p]- Maximum number of perks increased to 30, that is +10 from 20.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Kevin.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update #1: Build 2 (Pit Champions)
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

This update introduces the 4 remaining pit champions which will round out all the champions for the pits. This is the first pass and there will probably be further updates to this.

[b]You will need to start a new playthrough in order to get access to the new pit champions.[/b]

[b]Pit Champions:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45376518/941293a328ee501d98c1fb06ad10fca72af4170d.jpg[/img]
[b]Overhauled Lighting:[/b]

- Overhauled the lighting in all interior arenas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45376518/e0e637a30fcfa7be5c0bd15cbf9bf2ad305261fa.jpg[/img]
[b]New:[/b]

- The equipment of recruits will now be displayed in the Shelter and Lodge.

- New masterwork armor sets have been added to "Local Championships".

[b]Changes:[/b]

- Sped up time transition when ending the day.

- Slowed down the height/zoom transition of the camera.

- You can now select your 3 starting companions rather than have them be randomly selected.

- Marketplace, lodge and shelters will now restock each day rather than each week.

[b]Fixes:[/b]

- Fixed the issue of the Lodge having Midland recruits when it should have only had Northlands/Southlands/Eastlands/Westlands recruits.

I will continue to go through feedback and iterate. However, with the limited time that I have the next update probably won't be for a few months.

Cheers,
Kevin.

notes.title: General Update #2: (Arena Monarchy Release Date)
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Arena Monarchy will be releasing into early access March 6th this week, 06/03/2025, 5:00pm PST. There will also be a launch discount of 10% for 2 weeks.

Thanks to everyone who wishlisted and downloaded the demo, as always your feedback and support is greatly appreciated!

As mentioned before, most of the content in Arena Monarchy will eventually make its way into Dead Monarchy so all the feedback on combat/balance will go a long way in improving both games.

Compared to the early access launch of Dead Monarchy, the vast majority of content in Arena Monarchy is already present. Aside from the legendary champions, the majority of foreseeable updates will be focused around combat balance.

Looking forward to hearing from you all. I'm on Discord and the Steam forums as often as I can be.

Link: https://discord.gg/E35jAfUKrp


Cheers,
Kevin.

notes.title: General Update #1: (Arena Monarchy Demo)
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Just letting you all know that Arena Monarchy is participating in the Steam Next Fest and that a demo for Arena Monarchy is now available.

Multiple new weapon types are available to try out right now and you'll be able to get a good grasp of the new fighting styles with the new enemies that you can fight against in the arena.

If you can't wait, Dead Monarchy is also on sale right now for 50% off.

A detailed guide is available here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3421339131

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383910/Arena_Monarchy/

Cheers,
Kevin.
